title: Elixir of Fire Resistance

sources.title: Elixir of Fire Resistance
markers: * Consume the potion to gain [[Damage Types#Resistance|Resistance]] to {{DamageType|Fire}} damage and immunity to [[Conditions#Burning|Burning]].

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain resistance to Fire damage and immunity to Burning until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain resistance to Fire damage and immunity to Burning until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one bottle. Applies the listed protection to creatures within 3 ft of impact until the next Long Rest.
fields.Crafting: Combine Ashes of Dragon Egg Mushroom with any Salt.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
